lines.text: Point one: the Line runs. Point two: I will tell the whole yard how crooked your stonework was.
The Line runs. The pump runs. The seal sits on my cistern like a hand on a shoulder.
Three apprentices. One crooked, one fine, one I corrected. The Line is theirs now.
There is a stone by the well. Hand-width. I cut it for names.

choice.text: Carve the apprentices' names. Mine can wait.
Carve the Keth family's mark first. It is their line.
Leave it blank. Names on wells draw attention.

lines.text: Adequate. More than adequate. Do not repeat that.
A blank stone. Fine. The well will remember without us.
